Great, varied menu and very affordable vegan restaurant in town
Apr 2024 • Couples
As far as we could see, this is the only vegan restaurant on Cat Ba island. They have a varied, tasty and very affordable menu and we ended up happily having several lunches and dinners there. The dishes are not as massive flavourful as for example Indonesian food but that’s just a taste buds preference. The other minor gripe is that the restaurant is open towards a small road on a slope where many noisy big tour buses pass by. So it’s not quiet and peaceful dining. But overall we enjoyed eating there every time. I definitely recommend it.

Taste Sensation!
Oct 2023 • Solo
I lucked out and, unbeknownst to me, I was staying upstairs from this restaurant for three nights. It is off of the main drag which means it is quieter and encourages a little bit of a walk, which in my opinion is always good after eating!

I have been traveling around Vietnam with a card that says, "vegetarian", as it isn't the most common thing here to not eat meat, so when I saw this vegan establishment I was excited to try it and I ate here three days in a row. 

This is my list of the different things that I had (I tried something different each time):

Drinks: Passionfruit juice & watermelon juice

Salads (I tried all three): Cucumber salad with passionfruit dressing; Mango salad and Banana flower salad

Main Dish: Quesadilla

Local dishes: Vegan dumplings

Special menu: Steamed Bao bun

Dessert: Mango sticky rice

Everything I ordered was made fresh, delivered quickly and finished off with complimentary fresh fruit. The service was casual, friendly and honest. If you are looking for a great place to eat with relaxing music to supplement the great cuisine, this is the place for you!
